findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The facility could benefit from a detail cleaning. There is observed soil accumulation around certain floors and walls throughout the facility. Also, accumulation was observed beneath and around large pieces of equipment. Ensure that detail cleaning occurs as often as necessary to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
A storage rack that stores freshly baked bread appeared to not have a covering on the top. Discussed with PIC and a baking sheet was placed on the top of the rack. Ensure that a baking sheet or any type of covering is placed over the rack whenever bread is being stored to protect against contamination.   

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The facility is in need of a deep cleaning. The floors, walls, and ceilings of both the back and the front of the house are accumulated with food/liquid splatter, dust, and overall debris. Ensure that all physical facilities are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent soil accumulation. When cleaning, be sure to pull equipment that has wheels from the wall to throughly clean floors and walls.  


6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The facility would benefit from a detail cleaning. There is observed soil accumulation around most of the wall-to-floor corners of the facility, around doors and legs of equipment, under wheels, and under equipment. Mainly observed is food splash and bread crumbs. See that detail cleaning occurs as needed to prevent accumulation of soil. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed caulking on the hand sink next to the 3 part sink to be coming off of the hand sink and wall. Ensure caulking is replaced so the hand sink is sealed properly to the wall. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Observed the soda nozzles to be soiled. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Soda nozzles were pulled for cleaning. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12  (C) Observed a spatula to be stored under a bread press, which is not a sanitized surface. Store in-use utensils: 1) in the food with the handle above the top of the food item; 2) on a clean and sanitized surface; 3) in running water; 4) in a container of hot water maintained at or above 135 °F. Spatula moved for cleaning. Reference 3-304.12.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16  (C) Mop was found stored incorrectly in-between use. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16

Mop was observed to be in mop bucket and not in a position that allows air-dry. Ensure mops are hung in a way that allows to properly air-dry. Mop was COS.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-305.11  (C) Employee clothing and personal items were found stored improperly. Food establishments shall A) Provide designated dressing rooms or dressing areas for employees that routinely change their clothes in the establishment; B) Provide lockers or other suitable facilities for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Reference 6-305.11.

Observed employee food within the fridge that was unlabeled and stored with facility food.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed tuna salad and cut tomatoes above 41 degrees in the top prep cooler. Cooler was turned down to allow food to maintain temperatures at or under 41 degrees. Tomatoes and tuna salad will be used in 4 hours or discarded. Facility also added ice and called the refrigeration repair company to service cooler.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
REPEAT > A make shift white wire rack next to the cash register has soiled, unsealed wood being used as a level. Clean the bare wood and seal or paint.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed the racks that hold the clean dishes to be soiled. Clean the racks that hold the clean dishes so no accumulated soil is visible. CORRECTED> Observed the bottom of the proofer to be soiled with dried dough and caked on flour. Proofer was cleaned during inspection.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed straws and lids being stored on the floor in the adjacent room. Store Single use items at least 6 inches off floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
REPEAT> The hand sink on the front line is soiled within basin around faucet and in caulking. Clean hand sinks and maintain clean.
750-1120f Lavatories, soap dispensers, hand drying devices and all related fixtures shall be kept clean and in good repair.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
REPEAT> Floors are observed soiled under the soda boxes. Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT> Wall around oven is soiled (there is a chair rail that holds soil) Clean walls and rail. NEW> Observed a hole in the wall near soda boxes. Seal hole.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
